verdict.rationale: Lambda is a hosted GPU cloud. Infrastructure vendors can plausibly offer on-prem or self-hosted deployments, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows the core product can be run on the user's own infrastructure. Private Cloud (dedicated single-tenant clusters with low-level access) and sudo/root on managed clusters are adjacent controls within Lambda-hosted infrastructure, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
